stem:
Spinner X is divided into 4 equal sections, and Spinner Y is divided into 3 equal sections. The possible outcomes for each spinner are shown in the tree diagrams.

Spinner X
1   2   3   4

Spinner Y
Red   Green   Blue

Both spinners are spun at the same time. What is the probability that Spinner X will land on 2 and Spinner Y will land on blue?
visual_elements: Spinner X tree diagram with branches to 1, 2, 3, 4
Spinner Y tree diagram with branches to Red, Green, Blue
